title: E2E Integration Test
description: Root schema for a vouchfx .e2e.yaml test file (language schema v1).

variables.description: Constant values pre-loaded into the shared variable context before the first step runs.

steps.description: The ordered list of actions and assertions that constitute the test.

metadata.description: Human-facing description of the test used in reporting and for suite filtering.

name.description: A short human-readable name for the test.

owner.description: The team or individual responsible for this test; used by the runner's selection language.

tags.description: Labels used to select subsets of tests during a CI run.

description.description: A longer explanation of what the test verifies.

schemaVersion.description: The language schema version the file targets (e.g. v1).

environment.description: Declares the infrastructure the test depends on — services under test and managed dependencies.

services.description: The system-under-test services, each identified by a logical name and brought up via an image or csproj path.

dependencies.description: Managed Aspire resources (databases, brokers, caches) that the engine provisions.

seed.description: Initial state applied after the topology is healthy and before the first step executes.

imageRegistry.description: An optional default OCI registry hostname that prefixes every un-prefixed image reference.

imagePullPolicy.description: Controls when the container runtime pulls images: Always, Missing, or Never.

step.description: A single typed step in the test sequence.

id.description: A unique identifier for the step within the file; used in reporting and failure messages. Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

type.description: The kind of step. Must be in dotted family.provider notation, e.g. http.rest or db-assert.postgres; a bare family name (e.g. http) is not accepted.

description.description: A short human-readable explanation shown in test output.

capture.description: A map of variable names to extractor expressions that write values from this step's result into the shared context.

verifyMode.description: Either IMMEDIATE (default) or RETRY. RETRY instructs the engine to poll with bounded exponential backoff.

timeout.description: An upper bound on how long the step may take, expressed as a duration string (e.g. 30s) or a number of seconds — enforced for every verify mode. An IMMEDIATE step that exceeds it resolves as Inconclusive (step-timeout, never Fail); where the provider's emitted body sets a built-in transport timeout (the HTTP, AWS and SQL command-timeout conventions), the declared value replaces it as the governing bound. For a RETRY step it bounds the polling window.

continueOnFailure.description: When true, a failed assertion is recorded but does not abort the remaining steps. Defaults to false.
